requirements.requirement: The system must include unit tests that verify providers are ranked in descending order by normalized score.
The system must include unit tests that validate deterministic ranking when two providers have identical scores (tie handling).
The system must include unit tests that verify behavior when one or more providers have missing scores.
The system must include unit tests that validate the comparison response conforms to the defined Pydantic schema.
The system must include unit tests that verify strengths and weaknesses are computed and present for each provider in the response.
The system must include integration tests that validate the evaluate_care_facade returns a complete comparison response for multiple providers.
The system must include integration tests that validate the tool_router correctly invokes the comparison capability and returns structured output.
The system must include integration tests that simulate LLM/tool usage and confirm the comparison tool is discoverable and callable.
The system must include tests that verify invalid input (e.g., empty provider list) results in a controlled error response.
The system must include tests that verify invalid provider identifiers are handled without system crashes.
The system must include tests that confirm consistent output ordering across repeated executions with identical inputs.
The system must include tests that verify measure breakdown data is included and correctly mapped to each provider.
The system must include tests that validate the comparison response includes at least two providers when valid input is provided.
The system must include tests that confirm API responses match expected JSON structure used by downstream consumers.
